author: Benjamin Geoffroy Dit Belhumeur
title: Children's Picture Book Illustrator Wanted: First Book of a New Series
content: Children's Picture Book Illustrator Wanted: First Book of a New Series. Belhumeur Books is looking for an illustrator for the first book in a new children's picture book series, and we want it to be the start of a long partnership, not a one-off gig. The project: ~640 words, 14 full spreads + cover, 8.5" × 8.5" paperback. Pay: $3,000 flat for book one, in four $750 milestones. Two shortlisted finalists each get $100 for a paid test. To apply: Email belhumeur.books@gmail.com with your portfolio link, 3–5 samples showing the same characters across multiple scenes and angles plus sequential pages, a sentence or two about yourself, your availability, and confirmation your work is original and human-made (no generative AI).

author: Chilling Tales for Dark Nights
title: Horror Illustrators Wanted — Paid Opportunities
content: HORROR ILLUSTRATORS WANTED — PAID OPPORTUNITIES. Chilling Tales for Dark Nights is looking for a handful of talented horror illustrators to create original artwork for us throughout the remainder of 2026 and into 2027. If you have a talent for bringing nightmares to life—from unsettling atmosphere to terrifying creatures—we’d love to see your work. Experience with illustrated lettering or incorporating text into your artwork is a plus, but not required. These are paid gigs. We’re seeking human-created artwork only. Interested? Email Craig Groshek with your portfolio, rates, and availability: craiggroshek@chillingtalesfordarknights.com Subject line: CTFDN ARTIST INTEREST
